description: EPA toxic chemical releases (TRI) — Toxic chemical releases from industrial facilities, from the US EPA Toxics Release Inventory. Area mode: zip= (or city=&state=) lists every TRI facility there with pounds released to air, water, land and underground injection in the latest reporting year, area totals and a LOW/MODERATE/HIGH release level; optional limit= (1-100). Facility mode: facility_id= gives the chemical-by-chemical breakdown with CAS numbers, carcinogen and PBT (persistent bioaccumulative toxic) flags, totals and plain-English flags. Optional year= (default newest available). Use for environmental due diligence, site selection, real-estate and community risk checks. Source: EPA Envirofacts (public domain). JSON. Price: $0.006 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: env_toxic_releases
